description: GTFS Ligne de bus Héoh is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service sig. Des navettes gratuites assurent la liaison entre la Gare de Clisson et Gétigné. Il y a 9 arrêts de bus qui permettent d’aller: à la Gare de Clisson, aux centres-villes de Clisson et de Gétigné dans la zone d’activités Câlin à Clisson: pour les emplois et les commerces dans les zones d’activités Toutes-Joies, Fief du ... Coverage: service sig. The publisher named on the listing is service sig. Its keywords include gtfs, acces-pmr, navette-gratuite, zone-urbaine, bus, transports-en-commun. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
